node.statement: Uniform target corner analysis. Let C_jk,n be the amplified compression Co_{P_j,P_k}. The compressed-corner formula and its uniform O(rho+epsilon) comparison with left-right multiplication, applied twice and using approximate orthogonality/complementarity of P_1,P_2 plus the epsilon associator and product bounds, give a universal K_0 such that for Y_lm in M_n tensor S_{P_l,P_m}, ||C_jk,n(Y_lm)-delta_jl delta_km Y_lm||<=K_0 e||Y_lm||, and for every Y in M_n tensor A, ||sum_jk C_jk,n(Y)-Y||<=K_0 e||Y||. Hence beta_n(Y)=(C_jk,nY) obeys ||beta_n alpha_n-I||<=4K_0e and ||alpha_n beta_n-I||<=K_0e. For e<=e_blk chosen so both errors are <1, the Neumann lemma gives alpha_n a linear bijection, with ||alpha_n||<=4 and ||alpha_n^{-1}|| bounded by one universal constant, uniformly in n.
